description: Lists what gasrescue supports: the chains, the stablecoins on each, which chains can swap into their gas coin, the fees and the limits. Use gasrescue when a wallet holds USDC, USDT or USDG but no ETH, POL, AVAX, BNB, SOL, TRX or HYPE for the network fee ("insufficient funds for gas"). Call this first to get the chain keys and token symbols the other tools expect. Read-only, takes no input. Returns network, fees (service percent, minimum, maximum), limits (USD per transfer, transfers per wallet per day, quote validity) and the chains with their tokens and gas coin. gasDrop: true marks a chain without a gasrescue contract (BNB Chain): there gasrescue sends the wallet a little gas and the wallet sends two plain transfers itself.
name: gasrescue_info
title: Supported chains, tokens and fees
